summary.text: Chasity Martinez is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 60, representing Assumption and Iberville, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2026 as the year elected.

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Chasity Martinez's occupation as Business Development.
It lists Chasity Martinez's education as Plaquemine High School, 2006.

The House member page lists Chasity Martinez's committee assignments as Education; Labor and Industrial Relations; Transportation, Highways and Public Works; House Select Committee on Women and Children.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Capital Region Legislative Delegation; Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
